items.title: Neutral-rate policy brief: r-star, nominal neutral rate, policy gap and market counterpoint

extraction.thesis: Policy stance is better framed as the policy rate minus an estimated nominal neutral rate than by the policy rate alone, but r-star is unobservable and market real yields contain risk and liquidity premia.
risks: false precision in an unobserved variable
confusing current CPI with long-run expectations
equating TIPS with r-star
ignoring balance sheet, fiscal and credit transmission
extraction.automationHint: Render definition, formula, dated gap and market counterpoint together. Recompute dated observations after FOMC, SEP, BLS or model updates; never retain a timeless current r-star number in the glossary.

framework.Q1: Which r-star definition and model are used, with what confidence interval and data vintage?
framework.Q2: Which long-run expected-inflation measure converts real r-star into nominal neutral, and is it a survey, projection or market price?
framework.Q3: What policy-rate observation and midpoint convention define the gap?
framework.Q4: Do credit spreads, the balance sheet, dollar, fiscal impulse and market term premium confirm or offset the rate-gap signal?
framework.Q5: Which new FOMC/SEP/CPI/model observation or market-premium decomposition would change the stance conclusion?

items.title: Visual supply-chain atlas patterns: graph, filters, chokepoints and beginner drill-down

extraction.thesis: A beginner-friendly supply-chain encyclopedia needs progressive disclosure: broad system map, filterable groups and criticality, searchable nodes, then definition, mechanism, metrics, downstream effect and evidence in a detail rail.
risks: copying proprietary company/edge counts
mistaking visual node size for verified market importance
overloading mobile layouts
hiding the text alternative
extraction.automationHint: Use the interaction grammar and information hierarchy, but populate AIO nodes and edges only from its own taxonomy and reviewed source registry.
